entry.name: TipDex-VTLA demonstrations
entry.title: TipDex-VTLA: Learning to Refine Actions with Visual Reliability and Tactile Feedback for Dexterous Manipulation
entry.summary: 50 released Egg Transfer demonstrations plus 50 synthetic lighting variants of them (94,172 frames in all, nominally 30 fps) from a right 7-DoF arm with a 6-DoF Inspire hand, with 364 raw tactile words per frame and three 224x224 RGB views; the paper reports 300 demonstrations over four tasks on two RealMan RM75 arms with Inspire RH56F2-E2-T1 hands, each with eight piezoresistive arrays (364 taxels).
entry.hand: Inspire 6-DoF hand on a right 7-DoF arm in the release (metadata: right_7dof_inspire_f1_6dof); the paper names Inspire RH56F2-E2-T1 x 2 on two RealMan RM75 arms

sensor.note: Paper: eight piezoresistive arrays per hand (five fingertip regions, three palm regions), 364 taxels per hand, sampled at 30 Hz. Release: observation.tactile.right, uint16 (364) raw transport words in SDK register order, with validity flags and timestamps; the metadata assumes no force conversion or spatial layout and says sensor refresh rate and force units are not verified. From the dataset card and meta/info.json; data files not opened.

scale.text: Released: 50 original Egg Transfer episodes (47,086 frames, derived) plus 50 synthetic lighting variants, 100 episodes and 94,172 frames in all; the paper reports 300 demonstrations over 4 tasks (200 for stage 1, 100 for stage 2)

entry.access: Hugging Face TipDex-VTLA/TipDex-Data, ungated (7.7 GB by the Hugging Face API; LeRobot v2.1 parquet with embedded images; uploaded 2026-11-19, last changed 2026-11-20; seen 2026-11-27). The project page says 'The public release covers Egg Transfer'; data for Grape Pinching, Tissue Extraction and Mung Bean Pouring was not found.
caveats: A subset: 50 original episodes of one task (Egg Transfer, 'Move the egg into the box.'), against 300 demonstrations over four tasks in the paper.

Half of the 100 episodes are synthetic: episode i+50 is episode i with perturbed RGB (low or strong exposure, directional light, moving shadow, uneven camera light) and the same non-image data; the card says they are not additional physical demonstrations.
Touch in the release is 364 raw uint16 words from the right hand; the card calls them 'not a verified physical taxel/pressure map'.
The release records one right arm and hand (13-D action, 19-D state) and its metadata names an Inspire F1 hand, while the paper describes two RealMan RM75 arms with Inspire RH56F2-E2-T1 hands.
No data license: the card says 'No new license is granted by this packaging operation; consult the data owner for reuse permission.'
The card says one split training source and all 8 development and 4 final-evaluation recordings are excluded, raw MCAP files are not bundled, and task success has not been re-judged.
All demonstrations were collected under normal lighting; the paper evaluates under unseen lighting without collecting data under it.

tracking.system: Inspire 6-DoF hand and 7-DoF arm joint states

unconfirmed: The tactile maker is not stated; the hand model RH56F2-E2-T1 suggests Inspire's own sensors, which the paper does not say. The catalog's RH56F1 record (8 capacitive sites per hand) does not match the 364 piezoresistive taxels given here, so no hardware link was made.
frames = 47,086 is half of the card's 94,172, since the 50 variants pair one to one with the 50 originals; about 26 minutes at the nominal 30 fps.
Coverage 'tip' and 'palm' and the piezoresistive principle come from the paper; the release assigns its 364 words no anatomical positions.
Camera models are the paper's; 224x224 and 30 fps are the released image size and nominal rate. Which camera model recorded each released view is not stated. Depth is not in the release metadata.
